nom: La Roche-Posay Lipikar Wash AP+ Gentle Foaming Moisturizing Wash

avis.texte: Great cleanser for dry skin. Does a great job of cleaning skin and removing makeup.

avis.titre: This is such a great cleanser
avis.texte: I have eczema so I need something gentle on my skin. This is fantastic for me and this will be added to my routine to keep my eczema in check.

So far, really grateful and happy with this cleanser! Had been using one that was leaving my face stripped and dry. Definitely a welcomed improvement! Also been trying out a moisturizer from them that is 👌
I always am looking for a face wash that don't leave my skin feeling dried out. This is it! Also, does not irritate my skin at all. Love it and will be my go to wash from now on.
Great products from a great company that I can trust for my skin care!!!

I have really sensitive skin and also have eczema, so even the "gentle" brands like Aveeno were leading to dryness and irritation. I tried this wash and I don't regret it! It is very moisturizing and gentle. I haven't tried it on my face, only my body, but it is a great product. It foams up well, but you have to use a couple of pumps. That is my only complaint. Either way, I will continue to buy this!

I really wanted to love this since I absolutely love their lotions, but I hate it. Decided to use this as a face wash to see how that does 1st, my face did feel clean however it seemed like it left too much hydration on my face as if I had a heavy moisturizer on and it caused breakouts. Then I tried it as a body wash, and honestly I like the Natrium body wash better and I agree with Natriums price point for their results. In my opinion this is just too pricey for the barely there results you get if your using as a body wash. Highly dont recommend as a face wash. Will be returning.
it's gentle and safe and going through chemo currently and they are a safe product
I recommend using this on your body, not your face. I woke up with very puffy eyes after washing my face with this product the night before. I think it would be good for dry skin on your body.

I really don't notice much of a difference. My skin is dry, and especially this winter, it's the driest it's ever been. I bought this hoping it would rehydrate my skin, but honestly I can't feel or see any noticeable difference when I do and don't use it. That's really frustrating because this bottle certainly was not cheap! Olay moisturizing body wash did a MUCH better job, and with a significantly smaller amount of soap… won't be repurchasing, do not recommend.
This was recommended by my dermatologist. I can already feel and see the difference on my skin. Less dry and itchy.

Its been a journey trying to find a body wash that doesn't irritate my skin. I've cycle through a couple of brands before finding this one. Its been great for my dry and sensitive skin, no irritation and left my skin feeling moisturizing.
I love this product so much. I have sensitive skin and this body and face wash leaves my skin gentle, hydrated, and moisturized. I would strongly recommend this body and face wash! It is the best!

avis.titre: Works so well for my oily acne-prone skin!
avis.texte: I have skin that tends to get oily as well as acne. However, keeping my skin better moisturized has balanced out oil production. My skin feels nourished after using this wash. My acne has also improved by using a gentle wash without any harsh stripping washes. The formulation is well-balanced in regard to its cleaning power and the hydration it delivers. I also use this on my body sometimes. I shave with a single-blade razor, which gives a very close shave, meaning it's basically dermaplaning my skin. It's also very easy to nick yourself. On nights that I shave, I like to use this wash since it's so gentle and nourishing for my skin.
I've been using it as a body wash & it smoothes my skin without stripping my skin barrier.

This is a good face wash, unfortunately for me my skin is too sensitive. As gentle as this is, it still caused my face to breakout and become red. I think this is good for someone who doesn't have sensitive skin.

My dermatologist recommended this brand. I didn't know which cleanser to purchase but I am very happy that I went with this one. It helped tremendously with my hormonal acne and the texture of my skin is the best its been in a while.
Very hydrating and clean your face really good I will definitely be buying this products again I love it
This is a very gentle, effective cleanser. I cleanse twice, so need a gentle product. It works great.

I have used Exuviance for years because it is the only one that would keep my face acne free and not dry me out. While I still stand behind it being a great face wash it is much more. I tried this one because I tried a new foundation that completely dried my face out and needed something moisturizing. This will be my new face wash!! It's much less of an investment, leaves my skin feeling clean and moisturized, and no breakouts like most cheaper washes. For reference I have combination skin that is prone to breakouts from most 'cheaper' products.

avis.titre: The best body wash for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have eczema and this is one of the few body washes that doesn't cause it to flare up. It's my favorite!
I wanted to love this because its very hydrating, but it created a rash on my cheeks by the 2nd wash. Same thing happened to my daughter who has eczema/sensitive skin.
I have sensitive, dry skin and this sounded so perfect. However, within 2 hours of my shower I was itching everywhere and my face was even worse. Still searching.

avis.titre: Foaming face wash that actually foams
avis.texte: Many face cleansers claim they foam but don't. This one foams but precisely the right amount. I bought this for my husband who has a lot of eczema on his face. This gentle cleanser feels moisturizing and he uses it every day. This is the only fase wash I can get him to use. You don't need a lot of product and the skin feels clean and fresh after using it. I can highly recommend this for eczema skin.

Okay guys I'm not gonna lie to you this product was trash it wasn't good for my skin it dried me out so so bad and then it was kind of tingling or burning I don't know what it was but it didn't necessarily burn my skin but like when I put it on it I was feeling some tingling but it dried me out bad.

I have sensitive skin and have had no issues with this body/face wash! Plus, double bonus that you can use this on your face and on your body. Clean ingredients and helps me with any body acne that pops up from time to time. I always buy this when there are coupons to make it more affordable. Highly recommend.

I have oily/ combination skin that is also acne prone. I LOVE this cleanser. It's gentle enough not to strip your skin, but effective enough to thoroughly clean it. I will use an oil balm makeup remover first then rinse it off, I use a little more than a pea sized amount and work it into my damp skin for at least 40+ seconds to get good foam. Also good amount of product for the price!

This si a good absic cleanser for the price. However, its not moisturizing. I have combo dry skin and it was still drying when i had more oily skin. I would use the smallest amount to try and avoid that dry, tight feeling. If you use their moisturizing lotion after it would be fine but this isnt grest for moisturize on its own.

This facial cleanser does not strip my sking at all but still manages to remove my makeup! If you find that the non foaming LRP cleanser is not great at removing eveything you should definitely try this one.

When the season changes to the cooler & colder weather, I find this helps to moisturize my skin and clean my skin without feeling extremely dry. It works well as a body wash and face wash. This is my go-to for the winter months.
I've cycled through countless cleansers in search for something that leaves my skin both moisturized and clean. I have VERY dry skin and this has been my holy grail!
I use this as a body wash. It doesn't irritate my eczema prone skin. I do wish it was a little more moisturizing.
This feels like absolute heaven on the skin! I use it after washing my body with an unscented bar of soap and it leaves my skin feeling like milk.

I was really hoping to love this moisturizing wash however i would not recommend. It dried out my skin so much to where my face started peeling got horrible acne & my face is really irritated with red blemishes all over I haven't broke out like this in years so im pretty disappointed with this wash.
This product is very good, it feels great on my skin. It's very smooth and not harsh at all. I would definitely recommend.

This is unscented so it has a faintly chemical smell to it. I have dry skin and was looking for a moisturizing product, which this is advertised- it dried my skin out horribly. I used this during the winter and my skin got so dry it started peeling, which is not normal for me. This would be great for anybody looking to dry out super oily skin but that's about it.
I have used this as my body wash for many, many years. It is gentle and leaves my skin soft and hydrated
This product made my skin SO clear! And soft, it lasts a while. I've gone through 3 bottles! It's actually so amazing! DEFINITELY RECOMMEND 10/10 💗
ive used this cleanser for about a year and went through atleast four bottles. its an amazing cleanser sometimes it can be drying but it gets the job done i have combo skin and its perfect

I recently started using the face cleanser love it. I have very dry and sensitive skin. This line so far has been the best for my skin. Rinses clean no residue, skin is refreshed and moisturized. No tightness or over drying. So far no itching.

avis.titre: I bought it for me and now for my teen
avis.texte: Love it, we both do. Super soft wash. It feels great on my skin.

avis.titre: This is the most amazing face wash ever
avis.texte: So I normally never write reviews but I have genuinely never been more amazed in my life. I gave up on getting rid of the KP bumps on my face nothing has ever worked until now. Completely changed my skin texture for the better. I highly recommend!!!!

for most of my life, I've had oily skin. in the last couple of years, parts of my face have become deserts while other parts remain oily. I've had red, dry, scaly splotches appear between my eyebrows, on my cheeks, and around my nose. I have tried so many cleansers and moisturizers, but none seemed to help. until I tried this. within a week of using this cleanser twice a day, my face completey cleared up. the dryness, the redness--all gone! all the issues I have been dealing with for years just disappeared within a week of using this product. truly could not recommend it enough!

avis.titre: The Best Product For Eczema Control
avis.texte: I have been using this product as a body and face wash and will never be using any other wash! I have had eczema since childhood and i have tried it all. Between the Eczema Honey line, Aveeno Oat Eczema line, and even the Eucerin Eczema Relief, this product along with the matching moisterizer cleared my flared up eczema in 20 days! I saw in one of the comments about the feeling of "tight skin" due to dryness, i personally have not had this issue as long as the shower water is not boiling hot. To anyone with itchy cracking eczema I highly recommend you give this product a shot!
Burned my eyes 🤦🏻‍♀️ Terrible cleanser ,I should have stayed with Ceravie

Love the stuff! I have been using for over a year, much less drying and more gentle than the regular soap/mainstream commercial liquids. Plus no horrible detergent perfume smell. Highly recommend for the body. It is not strong enough to take off daily sunscreen, though; I need LRP's Blue wash, which is an effective stripper.
I was expecting more using the soap and the lotion but my skin did not get moisture.

I have used the Toleriane gentle cleanser on my face for years and it's great. I tried this one thinking it would be even better, but it dried out my skin so much that's peeling. I'm getting back to Toleriane.

avis.titre: Holy grail cleanser for sensitive acne prone skin!
avis.texte: This is my favorite cleanser! Love that it has a pump that locks. It cleanses really well without stripping it causing any irritation. My face feels smooth and soothed after using. You also don't need allot so the bottle will last some time! It doesnt make me oily or break me out and thars a huge factor! Its also fragrance free!!
Outstanding product that leaves you skin clean and moisturized

avis.titre: Not good for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: It says this is good for sensitive skin and dry, extra dry, and even babies… well I have dry skin and this made my skin way dry. I have to return after 3 uses, because the third one burned the skin on my face a neck:(
I have been using this brand/product for years. My skin feels fully cleansed but not dry. A very small amount goes a long way.

avis.titre: Not what it says it is
avis.texte: This product is not the normal standard for this brand. It smells horrible, is very drying, and is not for people with sensitive skin.

I have been using the Toleriane hydrating gentle cleanser for normal to dry skin with great success, I have rosacea and my skin need lots of extra hydrating. When I saw La Roche-Posay made a cleanser for dry to extra dry skin I thought it would be even better. But no it just burned my skin and made it so dry and tight, it looks like it is peeling from a sunburn. Just terrible
I needed a body wash to help with my dry skin in the winter, my elbows were starting to peel. Honestly, after the first use my skin was softer. It's not as soapy as I would like to be.
I love this body wash! no more alligator skin in the winter. I wish it was available in a jumbo size or a less plastic refill.

I love the La Roche Posay sunscreen, so thought I would give this product a try for my dry face. I used it for a few days, but it made my face burn honestly and feel extremely tight. My skin got super dry, which is basically the opposite reason of what I bought it for. I have never really used skincare products before, so this was my first one, but honestly it was a negative experience. Maybe it just doesn't work well for me, so I'll have to try another product.

Tremendous value for the price. I have used almost every cleanser Under the Sun, and this one by far works wonders. Gently cleanses my skin thoroughly. I recommend foaming cleanser and brand to everyone I know.

Omg I have extremely dry skin that breaks out with excess no matter what I use. This has moisturized my skin, no flaky, itchy skin and my legs are smooths now I just need to get rid of the dark spots. Thank you so very much.
This body wash has been amazing for my skin post cancer treatment. I've tried everything and this one definitely works the best.
Love the body wash, ive noticed my skin is not so flaky anymore.

avis.titre: Burned and left my face red
avis.texte: My skin is not even sensitive and this made my face red and it burned! Not for senstive skin at all
This is a mild foaming face wash, absolutely made my face feel so clean without striping away the natural moisture. Highly Recommend.

Like most others who have this one star, this caused my skin to become more dry, itchy, red and slightly burn. I thought it was anther product because this had such glorious reviews for dry, sensitive skin. I finally switched my wash to something else and my skin's barrier immediately began to heal.
This is the best I've found for my 100% dry skin, it doesn't get rid of my dry skin but helps a lot!

avis.titre: Not Sure This Is Worth It
avis.texte: It does the nothing special compared to Cerave's Hydrating Cleanrr. My skin had turned a bit oiler in the past year and it's no longer dry, so this one is no longer necessary. I've used up the bottle. Going back to that one for cost. I like that it has niacinimide in it.
Loved the first bottle, so I bought a second one and everytime I use it I'm having allergic reactions?? Did the formula change or why is this happening?

Every winter I experience dry skin, no matter which product I use claiming to help or heal dry skin. Nothing seemed to work. I decided to try LaRoche-Posay moisturizing wash. Since I tried other products and nothing helped, I was very skeptical that I would see any results with this product. I am halfway through the bottle, and I am in love. This product exceeded my expectation.

Started using this product as recommended by a Dr, when I was diagnosed with Shingles back in 2020! It is really just an amazing product, being fragrance free and mosturizing. Feel so much cleaner than when using ordinary shower soaps. However, sadly, it seems more difficult to find each time I try to purchase!
Dried out my face and body very badly. Even using other moisturizers afterwards my skin just felt like sandpaper it was so dry.

avis.titre: good for my bacne but broke my face out :(
avis.texte: I bought this because my proactiv cleanser was too rough on my skin and wanted something better. I used this wash daily for a week and so far I have broken out in areas on my face I haven't before. I don't know if I should keep using it and maybe it would go away or find something new :(
Great for my daughter who had eczema just wish it was a bigger bottle constantly buying this as it's a body and face wash for her
I love this facial wash ,removes my makeup and leaves my skin soft.I do get a lot of compliments on my skin.
Love this product! Its gentle, moisturizing hydrating, makes your skin soft, and also add a glow! Definitely recommend
The most satisfying face wash ever. After I exfoliate my face, this face wash doesn't burn or irritate my sensitive skin.

I bought this a bit after I had started a new skincare routine, my skin was doing so much better then this arrived, the morning after I used it I had so many dry patches on my skin and my skin felt super tight. Would not recommend.

avis.titre: I will never go back to soap
avis.texte: My skin has never felt softer or less irritated. No itchiness, no flaking, just pure softness.
Not as moisturizer as I expected. I tried Other less expensive brands and left the skin soft and moisturizing

avis.titre: Dispenser failed on 2 bottles. Cleans well.
avis.texte: I love this product, hate the pump. I tranferred it to another bottle. A dime sized squirt cleans my face neck and the tops of my shoulders. Cleans clogged pores like no product I ever used, and does not leave me feeling dried out. Great on bacne and chestne. I still moisurize afterwards bc of my age. I have been unable to find it. Is there a production problem or is it discontinued?

I love this body wash, very reliable. It's never in stock anymore, i hope they don't discontinue :(. I have have psoriasis all my life and this wash makes my skin feel very clean with 0 residue or tightness of the skin. would love to see a formula similar to this in a soap bar form. I do have to note that the last time I purchased this soap, towards the last few months of using the product, a thin layer of a dark midlew-y substance was in the bottle which I found strange. I felt as if that wasn't something that was supposed to happen since I've purchased this product before in the past without a problem. Regardless, I moved to the other foaming wash by LRP.

I normally use the LA Roche-Posay clarifying cleanser which I love but since winter is near, I figured I'd try a more moisturizing cleanser and an influencer on YouTube suggested this wash for your face so I figured I'd give it a try. I don't have sensitive skin and this cleanser burned my face and neck so bad. The purifying cleanser has less ingredients which is funny because this wash is suppose to be for sensitive skin. Sometimes less is more. I had to go back to my clarifying la roche posay cleanser and vanicream moisturizing cream. La roche posay triple repair also burned my non sensitive skin. Again, vanicream is more basic but I guess that's a good thing

I dont normally have sensitive skin and have used so many products none of which caused a reaction like this one. I keep my skin care super simple these days so I mainly cleanse and moisturize. I bought this because my skin is super dry coming into the winter months so i wanted something gentle and moisturizing. This did the exact opposite. After using just one time, my skin broke out in hives and really didn't see much moisture from this. I used it a second time to see if it would happen again and after coming out of the shower my skin was blotchy and red. It did calm down after a few minutes but never have I ever had a reaction to something like that and this product claims its for sensitive skin. I will be returning.
11/10 , I have really oily skin and this is the best product I have found
After using this body wash and lotion my skin felt very tight and actually felt very dry.

avis.titre: Possibly mixed up with oil control face wash?
avis.texte: I've been using it for a month hoping that I just had to get used to it but it is the opposite of described. My skin looks and feels like it was washed with a bar of mechanics soap. It is tight and shiny like stripped of any moisture whatsoever.

Lipikar wash AP+ for body and face feels great. Not drying at all and no excessive foaming. I do wish it came in a squeeze tube instead of pump dispenser because of environmental concerns. My understanding is that the pump cannot be recycled, whereas the empty, rinsed tube can. Clarification from Laroche Posay would be greatly appreciated.
So far great! I'm more on the normal side for my skin type and accidentally picked this up but have 0regrets it's def. Moisturizing!

My husband got this in a subscription box, and I tried it out. I believe I am allergic to it as it irritated my skin and gave me a rash that took a few days to get rid of. I had a large raised rash on my face which really bothered me. I don't recommend using it all over right away. I recommend doing a patch test if you have sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Not A Good Product For Me
avis.texte: I ordered this after reading the reviews. I'm so disappointed. It stung my face & felt like I was using dish soap instead of a gentle cleanser. I'll stick with Dove. It doesn't hurt my skin & is far less expensive.
Great for the skin, making it soft and radiant. Excellent for daily use. It is a moisturizer and cleanser. I advise everyone to use it…packaging it is very good…Smells beautiful and soft.

I have been using La Roche-Posay Lipikar Wash for a little over a week now, and so far I love it. A little goes a long way, with a really nice lather. It is non drying, so my face doesn't feel tight after I use it. I will definitely buy it again.
I have really dry skin and this face wash with a combo of a good serum really made my skin feel better

Best cleanser I've ever used. My face feels smooth , hydrated and just better ever since I started using this product. I use it every night before bed and and in the shower before I go to work. And you don't really need to use A lot which makes it last longer saving you money.
This has significantly improved my 3 year olds dry scalp, and my dry skiing on my face and arms! Will be part of every shopping trip,

I have used a product in the shower that allows my skin to feel smooth and hydrated enough to skip an oil or lotion afterward. I can use this on my face too without any redness or stinging. I have EXTREMELY dry skin which is also prone to eczema. This body wash is both a time-saver and cost-saver for me.

My face and body skin can easily get itch with products, but this product never caused itching at all. It's gentle and very suitable for dry skin; I don't need extra body moisturizer most of the time. It's expensive, but I keep repurchasing it because it' just so good.
I really like this face and body wash and I use it for both. I always love the la roche-posts products and this one does not disappoint either! It is moisturizing

avis.titre: Not great for my face but GREAT for body wash
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and rosacea. It broke me out just a tiny bit on the face for rosacea acne, but. might work in the winter when it comes, just too hot here in TX now. It was great as a body wash though, even though I think it says face wash. I only have one other body wash I can use right now that doesn't break me out, and this worked great for that purpose. I read it from another reviewer so tried it, and YES now my new favorite body wash for sensitive dry skin.

So sorry, but this did exactly the opposite of what it was supposed to do. It was drying and irritating to my skin. I was also upset that it had polyethylene glycol in it, which is a known carcinogen. Just disappointed.

avis.titre: Finally something that I can use
avis.texte: I have a lot of allergies and this wash is a game changer. I don't constantly itch after using it which happens with a lot of products. Really love this! I'd definitely recommend this to anyone that has a lot of allergies, especially PEG.
makes my skin soft and i love it i would use it everyday. def recommend and i will be using it again because i am in love with this stuff. does smell great to

My esthetician who waxes me told me to switch to a new body wash as we discovered fragrance and ingredients were causing redness irritation and dry skin, even though it was a popular moisturizing wash. I needed to use moisturizer twice daily and my skin was still dry and flaky. I switched to this and in ONE use my skin changed. No texture or dryness, and so much hydration. Absolutely no fragrance or irritation whatsoever. I feel clean and i can go WITHOUT body lotion because of this body wash. I no longer have redness ingrowns or irritation and my skin looks and feels healthier. Will repurchase for life.

Literally one of the only face washes that doesn't make my eczema flair! I have very sensitive skin that is combo and acne prone. This brand, and wash specifically, is my holy grail! I used to use the normal hydrating gentle cleaner when I first tried this brand but it was still leaving my skin a little too dry. Highly recommend this for anyone dealing with eczema on their face!

avis.titre: Dried my face out and gave me an allergic reaction
avis.texte: Gave me an allergic reaction, red itchy bumps all over my face

this foams up nicely has no strong smell and makes you feel clean. because its gentle it doesn't leave your skin feeling tight, so its great for double cleansing when you wear make-up or spf. love that you can use it for the body as well, i use it when my skin is feeling dry especially in the winter.

I read the reviews before buying and after seeing a 4.5 rating with over 600 reviews, I decided to try it. I have dry skin, genuine dry skin, and this just dried it more. If people on here claim to have dry skin and that this works for them, Id struggle to believe they actually have dry skin. The left side of my lower face is so dry, im starting to peel a bit. I really wanted to love this. I know its not my makeup either because ive never switched makeup products.
Hidratación al 100% , tengo eczem y esta crema funciona de éxito en mi cuerpo

avis.titre: Great body wash for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I've been using this body wash for my eczema prone skin and it has been making my skin less dry. It also helped lighten some hyperpigmentation on my body that was from insect bites.

avis.titre: Great Purchase, so glad I did
avis.texte: Love it. It takes my makeup off beautifully at the end of the day. I keep the moisturize version in the shower for morning
Super drying to my already dry, sensitive skin. I could not imagine using this on a baby!
